records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We, together with our subsidiaries, historically have been a short-to-medium haul truckload carrier with approximately 99.9% of our operating revenue was derived from shipments within the United States with the remainder being Canada and no operations in Mexico.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In early 2022, freight demand was initially strong, following an extended period of freight demand at peak levels that began in mid 2020 and continued throughout 2021 and into 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Because of these limitations, operating revenue excluding fuel surcharge revenue, adjusted operating income, and adjusted operating ratio should not be considered measures of income generated by our business or discretionary cash available to us to invest in the growth of our business.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During March 2022 Department of Energy ("DOE") average fuel prices increased to over $5.00 per gallon and remained elevated for the remainder of 2022, although the DOE weekly average for the last four weeks of 2022 fell below $5.00 per gallon.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Therefore, our operating income is negatively impacted with increased net fuel costs (fuel expense less fuel surcharge revenue) in a rising fuel environment and is positively impacted in a declining fuel environment.
